Among the named dependencies, only product-catalog shows failures: its GetProduct server spans report ERROR (5.105) with description 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled' (trace ids 78f49366602016cea7d3b9c41e20b29d, ade5d1967375ce6738b532044e6d3343). payment shows no observed failure (Charge grpc status 2 increase = 0; no error statuses in sampled payment spans), and no error statuses were observed on sampled cart, currency, shipping or email spans; those services' error counters were not returned, so their error counts are unknown rather than zero. Absolute latencies observed are small (checkout server p95 PlaceOrder 96.25 ms on grpc status 0; sampled PlaceOrder 24-88 ms; sampled dependency calls 0.02-17 ms), but with a single authorized window and no baseline, no latency elevation can be inferred, and the causal chain from the product-catalog failure to the checkout errors is a hypothesis, not a proven edge.
